Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Farmhouse Decor Wall Clock and Mail Storage Organizer - 38 Inch, Wood with Black Detail
Colors: Black
Materials: hardwood
With a vintage clock and slots for storing mail, this piece will keep you organized while providing wall décor. Iron and wood with a distressed finish give it a charming rustic look ideal for modern, farmhouse or industrial settings. 14.25" W x 38" H Constructed from hardwood with iron accents on the clock face Ready to hang, all hardware included
